name: Bandarion Keep

angles.text: Bandarion Keep serves as a stronghold stewarded by Danitha and her fellow paladins, maintaining a holy bastion against dark forces in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.answer: Leonid Barthalomew is a commander of the Argent Dawn. He previously used Bandarion Keep as a base during earlier Scourge incursions into Tirisfal Glades, and he has returned there to meet with Danitha and her paladins.

Bandarion Keep is a fortress located in western Tirisfal Glades. Originally an Argent Dawn outpost during Scourge assaults, it fell into disrepair when the order pulled back to the Plaguelands before being restored and held by Danitha's paladins.

Danitha is a paladin who took over stewardship of Bandarion Keep alongside her order after the Argent Dawn withdrew east to the Plaguelands. She also named the keep in tribute to a mutual friend shared with Leonid Barthalomew.

aliases: why was it named bandarion keep
faq.answer: The fortress was named by Danitha in honor of a mutual friend known to both her and Commander Leonid Barthalomew.
faq.q: Why is it called Bandarion Keep?

faq.answer: Members of the Argent Dawn journey to Bandarion Keep to coordinate with Danitha's paladins and maintain vigilance against Scourge forces and Cult of the Damned activity across Tirisfal Glades.
faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn interested in Bandarion Keep?

aliases: what happened to the keep after the war
why did argent dawn leave bandarion keep
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn withdrew from the fortress when they shifted their main forces eastward to battle the Scourge in the Plaguelands, leaving the structure empty until Danitha and her paladins stepped in to maintain it.
faq.q: Why did the Argent Dawn previously abandon the keep?

sections.body: Bandarion Keep is an Argent Dawn quest that directs adventurers across Tirisfal Glades to meet Commander Leonid Barthalomew. After aiding the Dawn against Cult of the Damned activity, travelers are pointed northwest toward the fortress to rendezvous with the commander and learn more about the order's ongoing crusade against darkness.
sections.title: A Summons to the Keep

sections.body: The stronghold once served as a vital staging post for the Argent Dawn as they combated Scourge incursions throughout Tirisfal Glades. When the Dawn shifted its focus toward the Eastern and Western Plaguelands, the fort was left behind and threatened to decay into ruin, until the paladin Danitha and her companions assumed stewardship over its walls.
sections.title: History and Stewardship

sections.body: Upon reuniting with Leonid Barthalomew at the fortress, the commander reflects on the memory of the battles waged from its ramparts. Though relieved that the stronghold has not fallen into neglect, he notes that Danitha bestowed its name in tribute to a mutual friend.
sections.title: Memories of a Mutual Friend

summary: Bandarion Keep is a quest in Tirisfal Glades directing adventurers to meet Argent Dawn Commander Leonid Barthalomew at a secluded fortress. Once an Argent Dawn staging base against the Scourge, the stronghold is now maintained by Danitha and her order of paladins.
